title: Accounts Receivable Card — Billing Frequency, Payment Terms, Late Fees, Suspension and Reinstatement on the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans
content:
Accounts receivable figures for the six tiers of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans. The billing side invoices, applies late fees, suspends and reinstates on the figures of the tier the plan is written at.

| Tier | Premium invoiced | Days from invoice date to due date | Late fee per month on an overdue invoice | Days past due after which cover is suspended | Reinstatement fee | Days after suspension within which cover may be reinstated without a fresh inspection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Annually | 30 calendar days | 1.5 percent | 45 calendar days | 0 USD | 30 calendar days |
| Parts Protection Plan | Annually | 30 calendar days | 1.5 percent | 45 calendar days | 95 USD | 30 calendar days |
| Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Annually | 30 calendar days | 1.5 percent | 45 calendar days | 125 USD | 45 calendar days |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | Semiannually | 30 calendar days | 1.5 percent | 30 calendar days | 195 USD | 45 calendar days |
| Major Component Protection Plan | Quarterly | 30 calendar days | 1.25 percent | 30 calendar days | 250 USD | 60 calendar days |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | Monthly | 45 calendar days | 1.0 percent | 30 calendar days | 400 USD | 90 calendar days |

## Column meanings

- **Premium invoiced** — how the plan price is invoiced: annually, semiannually, quarterly or monthly.
- **Days from invoice date to due date** — the payment term of the tier, in calendar days.
- **Late fee per month** — the late fee on an overdue invoice, as a percent of the invoice per month.
- **Days past due after which cover is suspended** — the tier's suspension period, in calendar days past the due date.
- **Reinstatement fee** — the fee charged when suspended cover is reinstated.
- **Days after suspension within which cover may be reinstated without a fresh inspection** — the tier's reinstatement window, in calendar days.

## The card in condition and figure form

| Condition | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Parts Protection Plan | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Compressor Coverage Plan | Major Component Protection Plan | Total Equipment Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Invoice unpaid past its due date — fee each month | 1.5 percent | 1.5 percent | 1.5 percent | 1.5 percent | 1.25 percent | 1.0 percent |
| Invoice unpaid this many days past due — cover suspended | 45 | 45 | 45 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Suspended cover reinstated — fee charged | 0 USD | 95 USD | 125 USD | 195 USD | 250 USD | 400 USD |
| Reinstated without fresh inspection only within this many days of suspension | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 | 90 |

## Card readings

- The Total Equipment Protection Plan is the only tier invoiced monthly and the only tier with a 45 calendar day payment term; every other tier has 30 calendar days.
- The Manufacturer Warranty Registration carries a reinstatement fee of 0 USD; the fee rises tier by tier to 400 USD on the Total Equipment Protection Plan.
- The suspension period is 45 calendar days on the three annually invoiced tiers and 30 calendar days on the semiannual, quarterly and monthly tiers.
